title: Contractual-obligation triage and draft correction
instructions: Prepare memo.md for the fictional Luxembourg client: a concise issue table for the signed services agreement, unsigned revised quote, and courtesy introduction; identify debtor, creditor, performance, and contractual status with uncertainty where appropriate.
